description: I will always choose the route that is less traveled because why wouldn’t I give this life a little more space to treat me to a good time 🥂 #selflove #chooseme #confidence #mindfulness #selfcare
transcript: I will always choose the most unconventional or alternate route because everything is everything and it's also nothing at the same time. I am not concerned about where I will end up along the journey as long as I'm enjoying myself along the process, as long as I'm having fun, as long as I'm exploring, because everything is everything and nothing at the same time.
